title: Seas the Day | 126 E Royal Fern | Vacation Rental in Santa Rosa Beach – Dune Vacation Rentals
h1: Seas the Day | 126 E Royal Fern
meta_description: Seas the Day is a light-filled 2-story vacation rental in Santa Rosa Beach with screened porch, two living areas, and private balconies. Book here!
description_expanded:
Seas the Day | Crossings District, WaterColor

126 East Royal Fern Way Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

"Seas the Day" is a light-filled 2-story home with an abundance of windows inviting the outdoors to the interior spaces. Pale shades of blue-greens and splashes of orange with neutrals throughout the home to create a fun, soothing and cool décor in the iconic WaterColor manner. One master suite is downstairs, and the remaining bedrooms are upstairs, including another master suite with its own private balcony overlooking the Park. Three bedrooms feature king beds, 1 is a queen and the fifth has built in bunk beds with a trundle bed underneath. All bedrooms are tastefully decorated and large with spacious closets. An additional half bath is downstairs. The only shared bath which has a tub/shower combo is for the queen room and bunk room which has a door from queen room and hallway. Each bedroom also features a flat screen TV with built in Blu Ray DVD player. The upstairs living area features a queen sleeper sofa.

The open floor plan has a beautiful living room, kitchen and dining room downstairs, and a fully-appointed separate living area upstairs. Each living area is equipped with a 42 inch flat screen TV with Blu Ray DVD players. Enjoy yourself in our fully-equipped kitchen, including beautiful, upgraded stainless steel appliances that make even playing in the kitchen feel like you're on vacation! The kitchen is stocked with an extensive selection of drinkware, dishes and all that's needed for cooking to your hearts content and easy melamine dishes for children or a casual bite on the go. Everyone's favorite spot in this lovely home is the rocking chairs and comfortable love seat on the fully screened-in front porch. Nestle in with a good book or a cup of coffee and float in the gentle beach breeze.

Our corner of WaterColor is unique in the area, allowing peace of mind for families with children. Guests step from the front porch onto the boardwalk 3 houses away to the lovely Dragonfly Park Pool, complete with gentle waterfall and enormous outdoor kitchen. Across the street, just steps away from your front door, are the wide open lawns of the Park, providing a haven for children to run free, and play tag, football, soccer, or maybe a adult game of bocce ball. Hurry to Seas the Day as quickly as you can…We promise you'll wish you never had to leave. Once you've experienced this magical place, you'll want to return to "Seas the Day" beach house time after time!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

First Floor

- Master bedroom with private bathroom

- Gourmet kitchen

- Dining table seating for

- Screened-in porch with comfortable seating

- Half bathroom

Second Floor

- Additional master bedroom with private balcony and bathroom

- King guest bedroom with private bathroom

- Queen guest bedroom with shared bathroom with bunk room

- Bunk room with twin over twin bunk and twin trundle with shared bathroom with queen bedroom

- Additional living space with queen sleeper sofa

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 vehicles

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional clean charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- 11 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking

- Except for a $250 cancellation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to arrival date

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
